sections.name: body
sections.value:
F256 closes at #308 head e637deb24f68674b418a5dd6972a6953dc35313a: an OMP model-bearing footer whose native-selector agreement check errors returns RuntimeModel::Unchecked, and the canary refuses with native_model, footer_model and catalog_error before writing a successful canary.

Independent pinned-SDK/exact-source replay verifies all five previously failing roles (smol, slow, temporary, fallback, prewalk) with stale native Opus, GPT footer and catalog Err. Refusal details, healthy disagreement and next-call controls pass. Own-name outage, missing selector and malformed inventory refuse. No/empty footer and non-OMP paths pass a panic-on-any-call catalog. Parent fail-open, no-footer launch and consumer-accepts-Unchecked mutants are caught. JUnit artifact 14688565883 from successful job 136704199747 in run 44857873715 has 2,738 testcases and no failures/errors.

A read-only current-fleet audit found four live OMP seats, all with known native facts and exact catalog rows: three use github-copilot/claude-opus-5.5 and one uses github-copilot/claude-opus-5.5-1m, in a 746-row inventory. Missing-row refusal is conservative inability to certify, not evidence a seat is invalid; future removed or extension-only models are not covered by this snapshot.

This is a brake: removing it only admits more canaries. No extra production launch or loop is introduced. F257 owns same-display-name provider-switch freshness upstream; do not infer F257 closure from F256. The review's product worktree remains read-only. Diagnostic replay receipts are in the private review session; no live canary or bounce was performed.
